# planetscale_neki_sidecar (Data Source)

NekiSidecar DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_neki_sidecar" "my_nekisidecar" {
  branch                = "...my_branch..."
  configuration_profile = "...my_configuration_profile..."
  database              = "...my_database..."
  organization          = "...my_organization..."
  parameters = {
    key = {
      # ...
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Branch name from `list_branches`. Example: `main`.
- `configuration_profile` (String) The name of the shard configuration profile the sidecar belongs to
- `database` (String) Database name slug from `list_databases`. Example: `app-db`.
- `organization` (String) Organization name slug from `list_organizations`. Example: `acme`.

### Optional

- `parameters` (Map of Map of String) Managed effective sidecar parameter values nested by namespace. Remote non-default values are adopted during reads.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the sidecar
- `state` (String) The current state of the sidecar
